name: Announcer
summary: One shared pair of live regions for the page, so messages screen readers should hear are announced once, in order, even when several arrive together.

when: Once, early in the page, so the first message is heard. Components announce through it.

whenNot.text: For anything people need to see: show it too.

anatomy.description: Polite and assertive, hidden on screen.

states.name: Present
states.description: Nothing to see; it holds the regions.

accessibility.name: None.
screenReader: Messages are read as they arrive. Several at once are all read, in order.
notes: Use announce(message) from any component or app code. Assertive is only for something people must hear at once.

guidelines: Announce only what people need to hear, in a few words.

dosAndDonts.do: Use one announcer for the page.
dosAndDonts.dont: Add a live region per component.

evidence.point: One shared region avoids messages talking over each other.
